event_summary: A cream-colored fabric backdrop moves over a colorful teapot and covers it until only a fabric mound remains visible.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a colorful glossy teapot centered on a wooden tabletop in front of a cream fabric backdrop. After a stationary interval, the cream fabric behind and above the teapot moves downward and forward into the foreground. The fabric edge crosses the teapot lid first, then covers the upper body, then the remaining visible parts of the teapot. The teapot becomes fully hidden beneath the fabric. The fabric then remains spread over the covered object as a peaked mound with small visible shifts settling into place.

reasons: The teapot is fully visible and centered.
The tabletop and rear cream fabric backdrop are visible.
No main covering motion is visible in the first frame.
